The context shows `provSourceOf` returns a `ProvSource` that is either `.file` or `.file_utf16` (src/scan.zig:1230-1234). The `ProvSource` enum declaration isn't in the context, so I can't confirm whether it has other values (such as stdin or archive sources), nor how they're serialized to the JSON "source" string. The `file-utf16` spelling is inferred from `.file_utf16`, not shown.

`provSourceOf` returns `.file_utf16` when:
- `config.encoding` is not `.none` and either `forcedBom(config.encoding) != null` or `config.encoding == .utf16` (src/scan.zig:1232). In other words, the encoding is forced to UTF-16.
- Otherwise, the data starts with a UTF-16 BOM, per `isUtf16Bom(data) != null` (src/scan.zig:1233).

It returns `.file` when `config.encoding == .none` (src/scan.zig:1231) or when no BOM is detected (src/scan.zig:1233).

This logic repeats the UTF-16 decision made in `processBuffer` (src/scan.zig:1228-1229). It is used on the portable scan path (src/scan.zig:905, 918, 937).

To get the full set of values, I'd need the `ProvSource` enum definition and its JSON serialization code.
